title: FRACMATH: A vectorized MATLAB framework for continuum damage mechanics with crack-band regularization
description: FRACMATH is a MATLAB framework for finite element simulation of fracture in quasibrittle materials using scalar isotropic continuum damage mechanics, modified von Mises equivalent strain, exponential softening, and direction-dependent Oliver crack-band regularization. The v1.0.0 release includes MATLAB solvers, benchmark inputs, generated results, plotting scripts, a matched Abaqus/Standard UMAT workflow, and a theory manual.
